I am a computational neuroscientist at the
[Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies (FIAS)](https://fias.institute)
and Goethe University Frankfurt, working in the group of
[Matthias Kaschube](https://fias.institute/en/research/neuroscience/kaschube/).

I study how reliable sensory representations emerge during the development of
the visual cortex. To do this I combine dynamical recurrent network models of
cortical circuits with the analysis of chronic two-photon calcium imaging data
from ferret visual cortex, recorded in long-standing collaborations with the
labs of David Fitzpatrick (Max Planck Florida Institute for Neuroscience) and
Gordon Smith (University of Minnesota).

I submitted my PhD thesis, *Emergence of reliable sensory representations in
cortical development*, in January 2026.

## Interests

- Development of the visual cortex and self-organisation of cortical maps
- Recurrent network models and their interaction with feedforward input
- Spontaneous activity and its role in shaping sensory representations
- Teaching computational neuroscience

## Education

- **PhD in Physics (Computational Neuroscience)**, Goethe University Frankfurt and
  International Max Planck Research School for Neural Circuits, 2018 – 2026
- **MSc Biophysics**, Goethe University Frankfurt, 2018
- **BSc Biophysics**, Goethe University Frankfurt, 2016
